title: Joshua's Charge to Leaders

questions.question: Who fights for Israel?
questions.explanation: Joshua 23:3 (ESV): "...for it is the Lord your God who has fought for you."

questions.question: What warning did Joshua give about mixed marriages?
options: They shall be a snare and a trap for you, and a whip on your sides
questions.correctAnswer: They shall be a snare and a trap for you, and a whip on your sides
questions.explanation: Joshua 23:13 (ESV): "...they shall be a snare and a trap for you, a whip on your sides and thorns in your eyes..."

questions.question: What implies Joshua's impending death?
options: "I am about to go the way of all the earth"
questions.correctAnswer: "I am about to go the way of all the earth"
questions.explanation: Joshua 23:14 (ESV): "And now I am about to go the way of all the earth..."

questions.question: What must they be very careful to do?
options: To love the Lord your God
questions.correctAnswer: To love the Lord your God
questions.explanation: Joshua 23:11 (ESV): "Be very careful, therefore, to love the Lord your God."

questions.question: If they transgress the covenant, what will happen?
options: The anger of the Lord will be kindled and you shall perish quickly
questions.correctAnswer: The anger of the Lord will be kindled and you shall perish quickly
questions.explanation: Joshua 23:16 (ESV): "...then the anger of the Lord will be kindled against you, and you shall perish quickly..."

questions.question: What does Joshua say about the good words God spoke?
options: Not one of them has failed
questions.correctAnswer: Not one of them has failed
questions.explanation: Joshua 23:14 (ESV): "...not one word has failed of all the good things that the Lord your God promised concerning you."

questions.question: What were they not to mention or swear by?
options: The names of these gods made mention among you
questions.correctAnswer: The names of these gods made mention among you
questions.explanation: Joshua 23:7 (ESV): "...that you may not make mention of the names of their gods or swear by them..."

questions.question: One man of you puts to flight how many?
questions.explanation: Joshua 23:10 (ESV): "One man of you puts to flight a thousand..."

questions.question: What will the Lord do to the remaining nations if Israel obeys?
options: He will push them back and drive them out
questions.correctAnswer: He will push them back and drive them out
questions.explanation: Joshua 23:5 (ESV): "The Lord your God will push them back before you and drive them out..."

questions.question: Joshua calls himself what?
questions.explanation: Joshua 23:2 (ESV): "...I am now old and advanced in years."

questions.question: What will happen with the threats of evil things?
options: Just as the good came, so the Lord will bring upon you all the evil things
questions.correctAnswer: Just as the good came, so the Lord will bring upon you all the evil things
questions.explanation: Joshua 23:15 (ESV): "But just as all the good things... have been fulfilled... so the Lord will bring upon you all the evil things..."

questions.question: What does Joshua urge them to keep and do?
options: All that is written in the Book of the Law of Moses
questions.correctAnswer: All that is written in the Book of the Law of Moses
questions.explanation: Joshua 23:6 (ESV): "Therefore, be very strong to keep and to do all that is written in the Book of the Law of Moses..."

questions.question: Turning aside to the right or left refers to what?
questions.explanation: Joshua 23:6 (ESV): "...turning aside from it neither to the right hand nor to the left."

questions.question: The Lord drove out what kind of nations?
questions.explanation: Joshua 23:9 (ESV): "For the Lord has driven out before you great and strong nations..."

questions.question: What is the "snare" and "trap" metaphor describing?
options: The remnants of the pagan nations
questions.correctAnswer: The remnants of the pagan nations
questions.explanation: Joshua 23:13 (ESV): "...know for certain that the Lord your God will no longer drive out these nations... but they shall be a snare and a trap for you..."

key_verse_text: And now I am about to go the way of all the earth, and you know in your hearts and souls, all of you, that not one word has failed of all the good things that the LORD your God promised concerning you... (ESV)
